description.zh: 根据手动工作流实例运行指定的业务时间进行匹配
description.en: The business date used for matching manual workflow instances.

description.zh: 根据手动工作流实例结束触发时间（创建时间）进行匹配，需要和StartTriggerTime配合使用
description.en: The end trigger time of the manual workflow instance used for matching. This parameter must be used together with the StartTriggerTime.

description.zh:
项目环境。

Prod：生产
Dev：开发
description.en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

Prod Dev

description.zh: 设置手动工作流实例的内部实例的匹配条件
description.en: The match conditions for internal instances of manual workflow instances.

description.zh: 根据手动工作流实例ID列表进行匹配
description.en: The instance IDs used for matching manual workflow instances.

description.zh: 根据手动工作流名称进行模糊匹配
description.en: The manual workflow name, used for fuzzy matching.

description.zh: 根据手动工作流实例开始触发时间（创建时间）进行匹配，需要和EndTriggerTime配合使用
description.en: The start trigger time (creation time) of the manual workflow instance used for matching. This parameter must be used together with EndTriggerTime.

description.zh: 根据手动工作流实例运行的状态进行匹配
description.en:
The status used for matching manual workflow instances.

Valid values:

- Success

- Failure

description.zh:
工作流实例的类型。

ManualWorkflow：手动工作流。
description.en:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:

ManualWorkflow.
